movie.title: And So the Night Fell
movie.overview: A sculptor sets up his studio in a remote rural area on the Galician coast. He gradually isolates himself, cutting contact with friends and family. A former lover's visit prompts him to reflect on his isolation and need to flee again.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A reclusive sculptor in remote Galicia is forced to confront his overwhelming urge to isolate and flee when an old flame unexpectedly arrives.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Seeking solace, a sculptor relocates to a secluded studio along the rugged Galician coastline. As time passes, he deliberately severs ties with his family and friends, sinking deeper into emotional solitude. However, his quiet sanctuary is disrupted when a former lover pays him an unexpected visit. Her arrival forces him to reexamine his profound detachment from the world and his lingering impulse to run away.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Driven by a desire for artistic solitude, a sculptor establishes a new studio in a quiet, rural community along the Galician coast. Initially focused on his craft, his withdrawal quickly transforms into total self-isolation as he systematically cuts off all communication with those who care about him. His world shrinks entirely to the walls of his workspace and the desolate surrounding landscape. This suffocating routine is unexpectedly shattered when a former lover arrives at his doorstep. Her presence resurrects buried memories and unresolved emotional conflicts that he had tried to outrun. Through quiet conversations and tense moments of reflection, the encounter lays bare the true reasons behind his chronic detachment. Confronted with the emotional mirror she presents, the sculptor realizes that his retreat to Galicia was not a creative awakening, but simply another attempt to flee. Ultimately, he is left grappling with the choice between confronting his inner turmoil or escaping once again.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the evocative and lonely backdrop of the Galician coast, And So the Night Fell is a poignant character study exploring art, isolation, and emotional avoidance. The narrative follows an artist who retreats to a remote rural studio to lose himself in his craft, intentionally severing ties with his friends and family along the way. When a former lover unexpectedly re-enters his life, her visit challenges his self-imposed exile and forces him to confront the underlying fears that drive him to continuously abandon his relationships.

story_structure.climax: Reconnecting with his past triggers a deeply reflective breakdown, forcing him to choose between addressing his buried emotions or giving in to his urge to run away.
story_structure.conflict: As he immerses himself in his work, an internal impulse drives him to sever ties with family and friends, plunging him into intense solitude.
story_structure.resolution: Accepting his pattern of detachment, he prepares to abandon his current life once again, seeking refuge in a new, unknown horizon.
story_structure.introduction: A passionate sculptor moves to a remote, quiet coastal studio in Galicia to focus on his craft and start fresh.
story_structure.risingAction: His profound isolation deepens over time until a surprise visit from a former lover forces him to confront the emotional distance he has built.
